title: Raster Zoom Camera Fix
description: Fix raster zoom: wheel zoom should scale the view without changing content appearance (logo should scale with zoom, not change).
summary: Fixed raster zoom so the view scales content instead of re-syncing layers on every wheel tick. Root cause: camera was included in WASM compositor sync JSON, so each zoom re-parsed layers and re-uploaded embedded assets (logo appeared to change). Fix: compositor sync omits camera/session fields; RasterCanvas keeps local sessionCamera (draw pattern) and only persists camera when it actually changes; wheel/pan use cavas::camera::wheel_screen; panning implemented with pan_last; pointer move no longer commits document every frame.
